description: Block that renders the excerpt pulled from another source page as sanitized HTML, with a source-page picker and edit-source link when editable, plus loading, not-found, and no-excerpt states.

parameters.name: Block
parameters.description: Owning page block used for persistence and focus context.

parameters.description: Raised when the block receives focus.
